description.p: LoFiBox is a pure C++ Linux music player with a compact chromeless desktop-widget surface, local playback, media-library browsing, metadata, artwork, remote-source, and DSP-oriented architecture goals.

Persists local media roots through source profiles, defaults unconfigured local library startup to ~/Music, adds source/library local-root CLI commands, and adds runtime library refresh for running instances.

Fixes Cardputer Zero APPLaunch startup by adding a wrapper that resolves the ST7789V framebuffer and keyboard device from APPLaunch environment or runtime detection, installs a stable device binary path, and uses a Cardputer-sized LoFiBox icon.

Realtime remix audio effects (Radio, Tape, Vinyl); async library scanning with per-phase progress bar; DSP limiter fixes and clip diagnostics; Cardputer Zero APPLaunch support; long-press Esc exit; About page with copyright and GitHub link.
